_comment: Round 6, chosen by a pre-screen rather than by hand, because rounds 5's rejects each cost a
build to discover. The screen applies the three gates that reject a port BEFORE any C++ exists:
- tools/verify_arity.py's test, that the mangled name's stack bytes equal the code's `ret`;
- build gate 6's test, that no dword in .data/.rdata points strictly inside the extent;
- a purity test, that the body makes no call and touches no absolute address, so it needs
nothing added to LINKABLE_GLOBALS and no unrecovered layout.
544 unported functions pass the first two; 146 pass all three.
The eight gfxTexture entries are empty in retail - the mipmap-environment feature was compiled
out and the entry points left behind. Porting them as no-ops is exact, not lazy.
aiPath supplies 35 of the 146 and none are here: its SharpTurn accessors read [this+0x24] as a
dword and index [this+0x28], but data/layouts.json types 0x24 as u8 and has no member at 0x28.
The class needs its layout corrected before any of that vein can be taken.
